shards.name: Ultima Online (official, EA/OSI)
shards.notes: Official EA/OSI servers. The first login server from the official Login.cfg. Requires the exact official client build and official login protocol.

shards.name: LegioN UO
shards.notes: Free Shard - APK Style level shard - PVP - Full loot

shards.name: Insane UO
shards.notes: Free Shard - Modern UO focused on PvM/PvE, enhanced loot and rewards, faster spawns, quality-of-life improvements, Champion Spawns, Peerless bosses and consensual PvP.

shards.name: UO Lost Lands
shards.notes: Free Shard - Second Age (T2A) era recreation. OSI-inspired mechanics, Felucca-only unrestricted sandbox, classic PvP, PvM, roleplay, housing and community events.

shards.name: UO Evolution
shards.notes: Free Shard - Highly customized Ultima Online experience with extensive PvM content, custom maps, monsters, quests, crafting, events and regular content updates. Includes elements from multiple official expansions.

shards.name: UOAlive
shards.notes: Free Shard - ModernUO PvE-focused shard with a friendly community and an emphasis on cooperative gameplay.

shards.name: UOGamers
shards.notes: Free Shard - Renaissance-era gameplay with classic open-world PvP, faction warfare, tournaments, seasonal campaigns and quality-of-life improvements.

shards.name: UO Renaissance
shards.notes: Free Shard - Renaissance-era mechanics without Trammel. Immersive classic gameplay with challenging PvM, open-world PvP, crafting, factions and a player-driven economy.

shards.name: UORPG
shards.notes: Free Shard - Ultima Online roleplaying experience. Client version supplied by user.

shards.name: Beyond Sosaria
shards.notes: Free Shard - Custom Ultima Online world focused on exploration, adventure and community gameplay.

shards.name: UO Eventine
shards.notes: Free Shard - Ultima Online custom shard. Client version supplied by user.

shards.name: UO Excelsior
shards.notes: Free Shard - Custom Ultima Online gameplay with PvM and PvP, custom maps, T2A-inspired elements and no skill cap.

shards.name: UO Forever
shards.notes: Free Shard - Classic Ultima Online-inspired world with custom content, open-world PvP, PvM, player housing and a player-driven economy.

shards.name: UOG Demise
shards.notes: Free Shard - Mondain's Legacy-inspired gameplay with classic PvP, Doom, crafting, Peerless encounters, PvM and community events.

shards.name: Inceptum
shards.notes: Free Shard - OSI-style Ultima Online experience.

shards.name: UO Outlands
shards.notes: Outlands: the account list, server list and game authorization come from the shard's HTTPS login (login.uooutlands.com:443). The profile stores its own device UUID; WispUO checks the HTTP login, but the shard's custom game stream is not implemented yet.
